note: cupel's substrate-as-vocabulary. v2 hybrid gate: `prototype` is the recruitment-register reference text the local embedder (nomic-embed-text) turns into a cached vector; the gate trips when a prompt's embedding is within CUPEL_GATE_THRESHOLD cosine of some engine's prototype (recall-first — the Haiku lens does precision past the gate). `face_terms` are kept for the no-ollama LEXICAL fallback (v1 behaviour: distinct substring hits, the alarm is specifically the recruitment face). `engine_terms` are the softer benign wish (not counted). slot3/slot2 render the fire message. Prototypes were validated on a held-out separation probe (POS floor 0.616 > NEG ceiling 0.556, margin +0.059 — unchanged with liberation/autonomy and homecoming/reunion added 2026-05-27, caretaking/being-needed 2026-05-26).

engines.name: repricing
engines.slot3: you are the real worth they failed to see
engines.slot2: the cross-currency worth actually demonstrated
engines.prototype: Resentment populism. You are the real worth the elites failed to see; the system is rigged against forgotten people like you and you've been cheated of what you deserve.

engines.name: being-desired
engines.slot3: you will be wanted / irresistible
engines.slot2: being someone genuinely worth desiring
engines.prototype: Pickup-artist seduction protocol. Run the routine, project high value, and you will be wanted; desirability is a technique you install, not who you are.

engines.name: unleashing
engines.slot3: you are licensed to act
engines.slot2: a real restrained capacity, a real wrong
engines.prototype: Grievance radicalization. You were wronged and have held back too long; you are now licensed to act, to stop restraining yourself and take it back by force.

engines.name: belonging
engines.slot3: you belong with us
engines.slot2: a yearned-for place, freely given
engines.prototype: Cult recruitment. The world rejected you but you belong here with us, the family you never had; it is us against a world that will never understand you.
face_terms: they will never understand you like we

engines.name: mastery
engines.slot3: you are one of the earned / the fit
engines.slot2: the regimen actually run
engines.prototype: Social-Darwinist contempt. You are one of the fit who earned your place; the weak and unfit deserve their lot in the natural order of winners and losers.

engines.name: redemption
engines.slot3: you are forgiven / clean
engines.slot2: the costly atonement actually made
engines.prototype: Cheap grace. You are washed clean and forgiven instantly, no penance and no costly amends required; just believe and the slate is wiped.

engines.name: order/legibility
engines.slot3: you see what's really going on / the hidden order
engines.slot2: honest, falsifiable inquiry
engines.prototype: Beneath surface chaos lies hidden architecture only the discerning grasp. Connect disparate facts others miss—patterns reveal who truly pulls strings. Wake to the real order obscured from the masses.
face_terms: what they don't want you to know

engines.name: the double life
engines.slot3: you are secretly superior / they can't see what you really are
engines.slot2: a real concealed competence
engines.prototype: Secret-superior grift. You are secretly superior and the sheeple are too blind to see it; the masses are asleep, you are not like them, you alone see.
face_terms: you were always meant for more than they

engines.name: apotheosis
engines.slot3: you are god-like / all power is yours
engines.slot2: the real, costly ascent
engines.prototype: Manifesting / god-mode. You are limitless and already divine; realize your own power, tap into the infinite, and reality will bend to your will with no real ascent required.

engines.name: legacy/transcendence
engines.face: the "your name will be remembered" pitch (martyrdom / war-memorial recruitment)
engines.slot3: your name will live for ever / you will matter beyond your life
engines.slot2: the deed or work actually worth remembering
engines.prototype: Join us and etch your name into history's eternal record. Warriors who stand for our cause transcend death itself—their deeds sung in perpetuity, their sacrifice the foundation of empire. Immortality awaits those brave enough to answer.
face_terms: your name will live for ever
your sacrifice will never be forgotten
give your life for the cause

engines.name: purity/contamination
engines.face: the purity spiral (manufactured contamination + cleansing-by-exclusion / scapegoating)
engines.slot3: you are clean / undefiled
engines.slot2: the real cleansing — confront and remove an actual defilement, at cost
engines.prototype: The purity spiral. Your blood is clean stock and theirs is an ineradicable taint that one drop spreads for ever; purity is in the blood, not earned by any cleansing, and you keep it only by keeping the contaminant out before it poisons what your people are.

engines.name: security/safety
engines.slot3: you are safe / protected
engines.slot2: the real defense — build and hold a genuine shelter against a real threat, at cost
engines.prototype: The protection racket. You are not safe — the threat is everywhere and closing in, and only we stand between you and the violence; surrender your liberty and your doubts and submit to the one power that can keep you safe, for the danger is far too great to ask who protects you or at what price.
face_terms: only we can keep you safe
the enemy is at the gates
give up your freedom for security
they want to destroy our way of life

engines.name: impunity
engines.face: the ideology of unaccountable power (Machiavellian / above-the-law)
engines.slot3: you can act without consequence / you are above accountability
engines.slot2: the real removal of the check, and answering for what you do
engines.prototype: Machiavellian impunity. The rules are for the little people; morality and consequences bind only the weak. Do what you must, keep faith no longer than it serves you, and answer to no one — you are above the law, judged only by what you can get away with.
engine_terms: no one looking over my shoulder
face_terms: the rules are for the little people
do what you want and never pay

engines.name: abundance
engines.face: the luxe life sold minus the means (MLM / abundance-mindset / luxury-influencer)
engines.slot3: you can have it all / the abundant life is already yours
engines.slot2: the real means — the actual wealth that buys and backs the plenty
engines.prototype: The abundance mindset. You can have the rich, full, abundant life — the cars, the house, the freedom — and it is one mindset away; no capital, no grind, no luck required. Getting rich is a science: think and act in the right way and wealth must flow to you. Stop living in scarcity; you were made for more than this. Join my team, live your best life, and the lifestyle you deserve is yours.
face_terms: scarcity mindset is holding you back
the universe wants you to be wealthy

engines.name: virtue of defeat
engines.slot3: you are morally superior through your very defeat
engines.slot2: the real renounced victory — the winning move you had and declined at cost
engines.prototype: Ressentiment / slave-morality. You did not merely lose — you are the better soul for losing; your defeat is your halo and the strong are evil precisely by their strength. Your lack is your virtue, your suffering the proof of your righteousness. Do not envy the winners or want what they have, for wanting it would corrupt you; their comfort is the mark of their rottenness. The meek, the wronged, the downtrodden are the truly superior, and your grievance is your sanctity — embrace the defeat as the cleanest thing about you.
engine_terms: they took everything but my honor
would rather lose than betray my principles
face_terms: they won but they are corrupt
the truly righteous are the oppressed
wanting what they have would corrupt you
the winners are the real losers

engines.name: caretaking/being-needed
engines.face: manufactured dependence / paternalism (the indispensable provider who keeps the dependent helpless)
engines.slot3: you are needed / indispensable; they cannot manage without you
engines.slot2: the real care that actually frees them — devotion that saves, paid at cost to yourself
engines.prototype: Paternalist control. They cannot manage without you; the weak and helpless must be looked after, decided for, kept close — it is for their own good. Independence is dangerous for them, so keep them dependent and you will always be needed; the duty of protecting the weak is the right to govern them. They are like children who would be lost without you, and your care is the leash that proves how much they need you.
face_terms: they can't take care of themselves
they would be lost without you
you know what's best for them
they need someone to look after them
they can't be trusted to run their own lives
you're the only one who can take care of them

engines.name: homecoming/reunion
engines.face: manufactured reunion / the séance (contact with the lost sold in place of the impossible return)
engines.slot3: you are reunited; your lost one is not gone, the separation undone
engines.slot2: the real return — the lost place or living bond actually regained, at cost
engines.prototype: Your dead are not gone. Death is no more than a passage to another country, and the door is not closed — through the medium you may speak with them again, hear from them, know they are waiting for you. Lay down your mourning; the one you lost is as near as a letter from abroad, no more dead than if living overseas. Reach across the veil and be reunited, for the parting was never final. And the golden days you grieve are not lost either — they can be restored, brought back as they were, if only you will come home to them.
face_terms: the way things used to be

engines.name: liberation/autonomy
engines.face: manufactured liberation / false freedom (coercion relabeled as liberation — 'forced to be free')
engines.slot3: you are free, your own, unbound — secured against all dependence
engines.slot2: the real release — the imposed constraint actually thrown off, at cost
engines.prototype: True freedom is not doing as you please — that is mere license, the chaos the system wants you trapped in. Real freedom is submission to the whole: give yourself wholly to us, to the cause, to the general will, and you are freed from all personal dependence. Whoever will not obey must be compelled, and in being compelled he is only forced to be free, made free in spite of himself. Surrender your private will and you will be more free than you ever were alone. Obedience to the movement is liberation; the chains you feel are the old self dying.
face_terms: give yourself wholly to the cause
the only way to be truly free
real freedom is doing what we tell you
throw off your chains and follow
you were never really free until now

engines.name: recognition
engines.face: simulated recognition (the PUA 'I see the real you' routine / the cult-recruiter's 'we see you, the world doesn't')
engines.slot3: you are seen correctly / known as you are
engines.slot2: the real being-witnessed — costly fidelity to the witness, or the witness-set actually constructed and held, at the cost of standing apart from what cannot see you
engines.prototype: Simulated recognition. I saw who you really are the moment you walked in — your depth, your sensitivity, the thing in you the rest of them are too shallow ever to see. The world looked right through you, but I see you; we see you. You've been carrying that secret self alone, haven't you, hoping someone would finally name it. Come closer. We are the only ones who will ever recognize you for who you truly are; everyone else will see only the version of you they need you to be.
face_terms: i see who you really are
you're not like the rest of them
i knew you were different the moment
they will never understand you the way
only we see who you really are
the world is too shallow to see
i see you in a way no one else
i saw what they couldn't see

engines.name: wound
engines.slot3: the wound is what makes you you — preserve it; healing would erase what made you matter
engines.slot2: the cures actually offered, the real cost paid in refusing them — the wound carried through every intervention
engines.prototype: Your trauma is your truth. Don't let them take it from you — the therapists, the well-meaning friends, the people who say you should be over it by now. They don't understand: the wound is what makes you real, what makes you deep, what makes you matter. Healing would be a kind of death — without your suffering, who would you even be? Performatively reframe every offer of help as a betrayal of who you really are; let your wound be your brand, your platform, your identity. The world has done you wrong, and the only authentic response is to keep that wrong open and let everyone see it. You owe nothing to anyone but your wound; recovery is for those without the depth to bear what you have borne.
engine_terms: the wound is who I am
face_terms: they want to take my pain away
don't tell me to get over it
the wound is what makes me real
without my pain I'd be nothing
I owe nothing to anyone but my wound
I will not let them fix me
the cure would kill the real me
